sessions.sshKeyMissingBody: No usable id_ed25519 or id_ecdsa private key was found in ~/.ssh (passphrase-protected or unsupported keys cannot be used here). Google Colab's SSH gateway only accepts Ed25519 and ECDSA keys (it rejects id_rsa server-side). Set up a key before requesting a runtime so compute units are not spent on a machine you cannot connect to.
